entries.title_en: MuseCritic: Learning Multi-Aspect Song Rewards through Natural-Language Aesthetic Critiques
entries.title_zh: MuseCritic：透過自然語言美學評語學習多面向歌曲獎勵訊號
entries.authors: Jiabao Zhuang, Changhao Jiang, Hanchen Wang, Jiahao Chen, Zhixiong Yang, Zhenghao Xiang, Yifei Cao, Jiajun Sun, Hui Li, Ming Zhang, Tao Ji, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang
entries.why_zh: 完整歌曲生成系統（DiffRhythm、YuE、LeVo、ACE-Step等）近年愈趨成熟，但既有評分模型大多把音訊直接映成分數，看不出判斷依據。MuseCritic反過來要求模型先寫出涵蓋五個美學面向的自然語言評語，再用評語當中介表徵去預測分數，並用兩階段訓練（教師示範評語做SFT，再用自我生成的評語做獎勵學習）解決評語分布偏移問題。消融實驗把「拿掉評語」「用外部教師評語而非自我生成」「拿掉SFT」三種變體都跑過，分別讓MSE從0.2316惡化到0.5005、0.5481、0.7541，把「評語為何有用」量化到具體數字，是一篇把可解釋性跟獎勵建模數字扎實地綁在一起的論文，故列為深度分析。
entries.why_en: Full-song generation systems (DiffRhythm, YuE, LeVo, ACE-Step, etc.) have matured quickly, but existing scoring models mostly map audio straight to a number with no visible reasoning. MuseCritic instead makes the model write a natural-language critique across five aesthetic dimensions first, then uses that critique as an intermediate representation to predict scores, using a two-stage pipeline (SFT on teacher critiques, then reward learning on the model's own self-generated critiques) to fix a critique-distribution-shift problem. Three ablations — removing the critique, using an external teacher's critiques instead of self-generated ones, and removing the SFT stage — degrade macro MSE from 0.2316 to 0.5005, 0.5481, and 0.7541 respectively, turning "why does the critique help" into concrete numbers. That's a rare case of interpretability being tied directly to reward-modeling metrics, hence flagged as a deep dive.

motivation.zh: 隨著完整歌曲生成系統（DiffRhythm、YuE、LeVo、ACE-Step、Muse等）日趨成熟，能生成長達數分鐘、具備段落結構與人聲協調的完整歌曲，「怎麼幫這些歌曲打分數」變成核心瓶頸，尤其是要用來做強化學習的獎勵訊號時更是如此。現有評分器（MuLan、MuQ-MuLan做文字-音樂對應，PAM做音質，MusicEval，Audiobox Aesthetics，以及SongEval定義的五個美學面向）幾乎都是「音訊進、分數出」的黑箱，即使SongEval把評分拆成五個面向，也僅止於分數預測，看不出模型是聽到了什麼具體現象才給出這個分數。作者認為，如果評分模型能像人類樂評一樣先講出「這裡的問題是什麼」再打分，不但分數本身更可信，這段評語還能反過來當作預測分數的證據，讓整個獎勵訊號變得可檢視。
motivation.en: As full-song generation systems (DiffRhythm, YuE, LeVo, ACE-Step, Muse, etc.) mature to the point of producing multi-minute songs with coherent structure and vocal coordination, how to score these songs becomes the central bottleneck — especially when the score is meant to serve as a reinforcement-learning reward signal. Existing evaluators (MuLan/MuQ-MuLan for text-music correspondence, PAM for audio quality, MusicEval, Audiobox Aesthetics, and SongEval's five aesthetic dimensions) are almost all audio-in-score-out black boxes; even SongEval, which splits scoring into five dimensions, still only predicts numbers with no visibility into what specific audible phenomenon drove the score. The authors argue that if a scoring model first states, like a human critic, "here's what's going on" before assigning a number, the score becomes more trustworthy and the critique itself can serve as inspectable evidence behind the reward signal.

intro.zh: 論文把相關研究分成兩條線。第一條是文字轉歌曲生成：近年的系統能一次生成涵蓋主歌副歌、具備人聲與伴奏協調的完整曲目，隨著這條線愈趨成熟，「怎麼可靠評分、怎麼提供適合強化學習用的獎勵訊號」變成核心挑戰。第二條是獎勵建模與音樂美學評估：MuLan、MuQ-MuLan關注文字與音樂的對應程度，PAM評的是音質，MusicEval跟Audiobox Aesthetics涵蓋更廣的美學面向，SongEval則定義了五個美學面向的評分標準，但這些方法「仍然只做分數預測」。MuseCritic把「評語生成」的能力接到音訊語言模型上，讓明確的美學證據能參與到獎勵預測的過程裡，這是它相對於SongEval等既有方法的核心差異。
intro.en: The paper divides related work into two threads. The first is text-to-song generation: recent systems can generate a full track in one pass, spanning verse-chorus structure with coordinated vocals and accompaniment; as this thread matures, reliable scoring and RL-suitable reward signals become the central challenge. The second is reward modeling and music aesthetic evaluation: MuLan/MuQ-MuLan target text-music correspondence, PAM targets audio quality, MusicEval and Audiobox Aesthetics cover a broader range of aesthetic dimensions, and SongEval defines a five-dimension aesthetic rubric — but these methods "still target score prediction alone." MuseCritic attaches critique-generation capability to an audio language model so that explicit aesthetic evidence can participate in reward prediction, which is its core departure from SongEval and similar prior approaches.

method.zh:
**問題設定**：模型輸入是歌曲音訊x、評估提示p，輸出是涵蓋K=5個面向、範圍[1,5]的專家標註分數y*。模型分成共用骨幹參數θ的兩個部分：評語生成器g_c = h_LM∘f_θ，美學評分器g_s = h_RM∘f_θ。跟直接把音訊映成分數不同，MuseCritic的評分器同時以歌曲、評分準則、以及評語c為條件：ŷ = g_s(x,p,c)，訓練目標是最小化MSE：ℒ_MSE = (1/|S|K)Σ‖g_s(x,p,c)−y*‖²。

**兩階段訓練管線**：第一階段（SFT）先用Gemini-3-Pro觀看每首歌、評分準則與專家平均分數，產生離線評語D_off，模型透過交叉熵損失ℒ_SFT學習複製這些教師評語。訓練設定：學習率5×10⁻⁵，在2,199首歌上跑一個epoch，四張H200，批次大小32（梯度累積）。第二階段（獎勵學習）讓SFT後的模型自己對所有訓練歌曲生成評語D_on，獎勵頭與骨幹的LoRA（rank 8、scaling 32）一起訓練，目標是ℒ_MC = ℒ_MSE(D_on; g_s)。訓練設定：學習率2×10⁻⁴，權重衰減0.1，十個epoch，硬體同上。作者強調用「模型自己生成的評語」而非外部教師評語來訓練獎勵頭，是為了緩解「訓練時看到的評語分布」跟「推論時模型自己會產生的評語分布」之間的落差。

**實驗設定**：骨幹是MOSS-Audio-8B-Instruct，訓練用2,199首SongEval歌曲（種子42打亂），留200首做域內測試，並用Music Arena（733組偏好配對）做域外測試。基線包含Gemini-3.1-Pro（LLM當裁判）、用相同資料切分重訓的SongEval（UTMOS架構）、以及Music Arena上的SongEval官方權重、Audiobox Aesthetics、Qwen3-Omni。評估指標：域內用MSE、Pearson LCC、Spearman SRCC、Kendall's τ（逐面向計算）；域外用嚴格意義的成對準確率（平手算錯）；下游則用GRPO訓練Muse-0.6B（500筆多輪範例，305英文、195中文），獎勵函數是r(x̃) = (1/K)Σŷ_k(x̃)，在SongEval五個面向與Audiobox Aesthetics四個面向共九項指標上量測生成品質的變化。

**域內結果**（Table 1）：MuseCritic在五個面向的MSE都低於SongEval，例如Coherence從0.2605降到0.2058、Musicality從0.2913降到0.2202，巨集平均MSE從SongEval的0.2875降到0.2316；巨集平均Pearson LCC達0.9068、Spearman SRCC達0.8838、Kendall's τ達0.7178。Gemini-3.1-Pro的巨集MSE高達1.3061，說明「沒有經過調適的LLM當裁判」沒辦法可靠地複製五維專家判斷。域外Music Arena準確率：MuseCritic 71.35%、SongEval 70.80%、Audiobox Aesthetics 68.49%、Qwen3-Omni 53.75%。下游GRPO訓練後，Muse-GRPO在全部九項Audiobox Aesthetics與SongEval指標上都優於原始Muse（例如Audiobox Content Enjoyment從7.33升到7.45、SongEval Coherence從4.01升到4.07）。
method.en:
**Problem formulation**: the model takes song audio x and an evaluation prompt p, and outputs expert-annotated scores y* over K=5 dimensions in [1,5]. It splits into two heads sharing backbone parameters θ: a critique generator g_c = h_LM∘f_θ and an aesthetic scorer g_s = h_RM∘f_θ. Unlike mapping audio directly to a score, MuseCritic's scorer is jointly conditioned on the song, the rubric, and a critique c: ŷ = g_s(x,p,c), trained to minimize ℒ_MSE = (1/|S|K)Σ‖g_s(x,p,c)−y*‖².

**Two-stage training pipeline**: Stage I (SFT) uses Gemini-3-Pro to observe each song, rubric, and expert mean rating and produce offline critiques D_off; the model learns to reproduce these teacher critiques via cross-entropy loss ℒ_SFT. Settings: learning rate 5×10⁻⁵, one epoch over 2,199 songs, four H200 GPUs, batch size 32 (accumulated). Stage II (reward learning) has the SFT'd model generate its own critiques D_on for every training song, and jointly trains a reward head with backbone LoRA (rank 8, scaling 32) on ℒ_MC = ℒ_MSE(D_on; g_s). Settings: learning rate 2×10⁻⁴, weight decay 0.1, ten epochs, same hardware. The authors emphasize training the reward head on the model's own self-generated critiques, rather than the external teacher's, specifically to close the gap between the critique distribution seen during training and the one the model itself produces at inference.

**Experimental setup**: the backbone is MOSS-Audio-8B-Instruct, trained on 2,199 SongEval songs (shuffled, seed 42), with 200 held out for in-domain testing and Music Arena (733 preference pairs) for out-of-domain testing. Baselines: Gemini-3.1-Pro (LLM-as-a-Judge), a SongEval (UTMOS architecture) retrained on the same split, and on Music Arena, SongEval's official weights, Audiobox Aesthetics, and Qwen3-Omni. Metrics: in-domain MSE/Pearson LCC/Spearman SRCC/Kendall's τ per dimension; out-of-domain strict pairwise accuracy (ties count as errors); and a downstream GRPO run training Muse-0.6B on 500 multi-turn examples (305 English, 195 Chinese) with reward r(x̃) = (1/K)Σŷ_k(x̃), measured across nine SongEval/Audiobox Aesthetics metrics.

**In-domain results** (Table 1): MuseCritic beats SongEval's MSE on all five dimensions (e.g. Coherence 0.2605→0.2058, Musicality 0.2913→0.2202), with macro MSE dropping from SongEval's 0.2875 to 0.2316; macro Pearson LCC reaches 0.9068, Spearman SRCC 0.8838, Kendall's τ 0.7178. Gemini-3.1-Pro's macro MSE is 1.3061, showing an unadapted LLM-as-a-Judge cannot reliably reproduce five-dimensional expert judgments. Out-of-domain Music Arena accuracy: MuseCritic 71.35%, SongEval 70.80%, Audiobox Aesthetics 68.49%, Qwen3-Omni 53.75%. After downstream GRPO training, Muse-GRPO beats the original Muse on all nine Audiobox Aesthetics/SongEval metrics (e.g. Audiobox Content Enjoyment 7.33→7.45, SongEval Coherence 4.01→4.07).

limitation.zh: 作者自己列出的限制集中在兩處。第一，計算成本：「先生成評語再預測分數」的流程需要自迴歸地生成評語，比直接做分數回歸昂貴得多，這對要大量取樣的強化學習訓練迴圈是個實際負擔。第二，資料侷限：同時具備音訊與專家美學評分的長篇歌曲資料集非常稀缺，MuseCritic主要在SongEval上訓練，而SongEval以中文與英文人聲歌曲為主，這限制了模型對「更廣泛語言與曲風」的類推能力——換句話說，這套方法目前驗證過的範圍，基本上就是中英文流行人聲歌曲，遇到器樂曲、其他語言曲種或非流行風格，表現如何完全沒有被檢驗過。消融實驗雖然把「評語」「自我生成」「SFT」三個因素的貢獻都拆解得很清楚，但這些拆解本身都是在同一個SongEval資料分布內做的，沒有回答「換一個完全不同的評分準則或音樂文化，這套流程還能不能成立」這個更大的問題。
limitation.en: The authors' own limitations concentrate on two points. First, computational cost: the critique-then-score procedure requires autoregressive critique generation before reward prediction, making it substantially more expensive than direct score regression — a real burden for RL training loops that need heavy sampling. Second, data scarcity: long-form song datasets pairing audio with expert aesthetic ratings remain scarce, so MuseCritic is trained primarily on SongEval, which itself skews toward Chinese and English vocal songs — limiting how well the model's judgments generalize to a broader range of languages and genres. In other words, everything validated here is essentially Chinese/English pop vocal music; how it performs on instrumental pieces, other languages, or non-pop genres is untested. And while the ablations cleanly isolate the contribution of the critique, self-generation, and SFT, all three ablations still run inside the same SongEval data distribution — they don't answer the larger question of whether this pipeline holds up under a completely different rubric or musical culture.

discussion.zh: 三組消融實驗把「評語為什麼有用」拆解成具體數字。拿掉評語（直接從音訊預測分數）讓巨集MSE從0.2316惡化到0.5005，而且拿掉評語後的預測「會擠在一個狹窄的高分區間」，顯示評語迫使模型真正區辨出歌曲之間的差異，而不是無腦地給出接近滿分的分數。把自我生成的評語換成外部教師（Gemini-3-Pro）的離線評語，巨集MSE從0.2316惡化到0.5481，LCC/SRCC/KTAU從(0.9068, 0.8838, 0.7178)掉到(0.8154, 0.7585, 0.5685)，驗證了「評語分布偏移」確實是真實存在、而且代價不小的問題。拿掉SFT階段直接做自我生成，巨集MSE惡化到0.7541，LCC/SRCC/KTAU掉到(0.6695, 0.6660, 0.5008)，說明「單靠自我生成、沒有教師示範打底」不足以產生可靠的中介表徵——SFT階段提供的並不只是起點，而是讓後續自我生成評語具備品質下限的必要條件。整體來看，MuseCritic在域內（SongEval）、域外（Music Arena）、以及下游GRPO訓練三種情境下都一致地優於或至少持平既有方法，證明「把自然語言評語當成分數預測的中介表徵」這個做法本身是有效的，而不只是換了個更大的骨幹模型帶來的提升。它把「可解釋性」跟「獎勵訊號品質」直接綁在同一組數字上，對後續想用LLM當音樂評審或獎勵模型的工作，提供了一個具體可比較的參照點。
discussion.en: The three ablations decompose "why does the critique help" into concrete numbers. Removing the critique (predicting scores directly from audio) worsens macro MSE from 0.2316 to 0.5005, and without it predictions cluster in a narrow high-score region — showing the critique forces the model to genuinely discriminate between songs rather than defaulting to near-perfect scores. Swapping self-generated critiques for the external teacher's (Gemini-3-Pro) offline critiques worsens macro MSE to 0.5481 and drops LCC/SRCC/KTAU from (0.9068, 0.8838, 0.7178) to (0.8154, 0.7585, 0.5685), confirming that critique-distribution shift is a real and costly problem. Removing the SFT stage and relying on self-generation alone worsens macro MSE to 0.7541 and LCC/SRCC/KTAU to (0.6695, 0.6660, 0.5008), showing that self-generation without a teacher-demonstrated starting point cannot produce a reliable intermediate representation — SFT isn't just a warm start, it's a precondition for the self-generated critiques that follow to meet a quality floor. Taken together, MuseCritic consistently matches or beats existing methods across in-domain (SongEval), out-of-domain (Music Arena), and downstream GRPO training settings, demonstrating that treating natural-language critique as an intermediate representation for score prediction is itself the source of the gain, not merely a bigger backbone. By tying interpretability directly to reward-signal quality in one set of numbers, it offers a concrete, comparable reference point for future work using LLMs as music judges or reward models.

entries.title_en: Pitch Contour Tokenization using VQ-VAE and Its Application on Korean Traditional Music Analysis
entries.title_zh: 用VQ-VAE做音高輪廓標記化及其在韓國傳統音樂分析上的應用
entries.authors: Seonguk Ju, Seola Cho, Sooin Chung, Danbinaerin Han, Dasaem Jeong
entries.why_zh: 大部分符號音樂分析都預設音樂可以拆成離散的「音符」單位，但盤索里（pansori）這類韓國傳統音樂的裝飾唱腔「시김새（sigimsae）」是連續滑動的音高輪廓，套用音符級轉譜會直接抹掉這些裝飾的細節。這篇論文不套用既定的音高格點，而是設計了一個VQ-VAE，搭配一個刻意迴避「切割位置敏感」問題的轉換最小化重建損失（同時搜尋時間偏移、時間縮放、音高偏移、音高縮放四種變換取最小MSE），從無標籤音訊裡直接學出一組256個離散音高輪廓的詞彙表。學出來的token不但能穩定地對應到專家定義的sigimsae類別，還能在完全沒有調式標籤的情況下，把兩個盤索里主要調式（계면조Gyemyeonjo、우조Ujo）的裝飾音差異分出來，是一篇把「轉換不變性」這個工程細節做得很扎實、又直接連到音樂學結論的論文，故列為深度分析。
entries.why_en: Most symbolic music analysis assumes music can be split into discrete "note" units, but the ornamented vocal technique sigimsae in Korean pansori is a continuously sliding pitch contour that note-level transcription simply erases. Rather than imposing a predefined pitch grid, this paper builds a VQ-VAE with a transformation-minimized reconstruction loss purpose-built to dodge segmentation-position sensitivity (searching over temporal offset, temporal scale, pitch offset, and pitch-range scale jointly for the minimum MSE), learning a 256-entry vocabulary of discrete pitch-contour tokens directly from unlabeled audio. The resulting tokens not only align stably with expert-defined sigimsae categories, but — with zero mode supervision — separate the ornamental differences between pansori's two principal modes (Gyemyeonjo and Ujo). It's a rare case where a carefully engineered invariance detail connects directly to a musicological finding, hence flagged as a deep dive.

motivation.zh: 把音樂表示成一串離散單位，是音樂分析裡最核心的抽象之一，西方符號音樂的「音符」正是這種抽象的具體體現。但作者指出，許多音樂傳統並不完全符合這個前提：像韓國盤索里這類以連續音高滑動為核心的唱腔，裝飾音「시김새（sigimsae）」本身就是滑音、抖音、轉音等連續運動，如果硬套用音符級的轉譜，這些裝飾細節會被直接抹平消失。要分析這類「以輪廓為核心」的音樂傳統，需要一種既能捕捉連續音高運動、又能提供離散、可計數、可統計分析單位的表徵方式——這正是論文要解決的問題：如何從無標籤音訊裡，直接學出一組屬於這個音樂傳統自己的離散音高輪廓詞彙，而不是借用西方音符或印度音樂那種人工定義的音高格點。
motivation.en: Representing music as a sequence of discrete units is one of the central abstractions in music analysis, with the Western "note" being its most familiar instantiation. But the authors point out that many musical traditions don't fully conform to this premise: Korean pansori singing, built around continuous pitch movement, expresses its core ornamentation — sigimsae — as sliding, vibrato-like, or turning pitch gestures that are inherently continuous. Forcing note-level transcription onto this repertoire simply erases that ornamental detail. Analyzing such contour-centric traditions calls for a representation that captures continuous pitch movement while still providing discrete, countable units suitable for statistical analysis — which is exactly what this paper sets out to build: a vocabulary of discrete pitch-contour tokens learned directly from unlabeled audio, native to the tradition itself, rather than borrowed Western notes or the hand-designed pitch grids used in prior Indian-music work.

intro.zh: 相關研究分兩條線。第一條是既有的音高輪廓抽象法：過去在印度藝術音樂上的研究，要嘛用音樂理論定義好的音高格點，要嘛把輪廓細切成10音分一格的精細量化區間；另一路則是用DTW相似度或矩陣輪廓（matrix profile）去挖掘反覆出現的旋律動機，但這類方法產生的是長度不一的片段實例，而這篇論文的做法是對整條輪廓產生「密集」的定長token序列，用固定詞彙表覆蓋每一段。第二條是VQ-VAE與離散表徵學習：標準VQ-VAE透過重建損失加向量量化懲罰項學離散潛碼，過去在音樂與音訊上的向量量化主要用在生成與壓縮，而這篇論文把它轉向「可解讀的分析單位」這個不同的目標——這個目標轉向，正是這篇論文在既有VQ-VAE應用光譜裡的定位。
intro.en: Related work splits into two threads. The first is prior pitch-contour abstractions: earlier work on Indian art music either used music-theoretically defined pitch grids or finely quantized contours into 10-cent bins, while a separate line mined recurring melodic motifs via DTW similarity or matrix profiles — but that produces variable-length instances rather than a dense token sequence. This paper instead produces a dense, fixed-length token sequence over the entire contour using one shared codebook. The second thread is VQ-VAE and discrete representation learning: standard VQ-VAE learns discrete latent codes via reconstruction loss plus a vector-quantization penalty; in music and audio, vector quantization has previously been used mainly for generation and compression, whereas this paper redirects it toward interpretable analytical units — that redirection of purpose is exactly where this paper sits in the existing spectrum of VQ-VAE applications.

method.zh:
**架構基礎**：模型用1D卷積層，搭配兩個關鍵設計。第一是接受域分離：輸入先被切成互不重疊的128幀窗口，確保token跟輪廓片段之間是1對1對應，並且每個片段都先減去自身的音高中位數，只捕捉相對音高運動（而非絕對音高），藉此避免解碼時各token之間互相依賴。第二、也是核心創新，是轉換最小化重建損失：標準的逐幀MSE會失效，因為即使兩段輪廓對應到同一種裝飾音型態，只要時間上有一點點錯位，逐幀MSE就會被放大成一個很大的誤差。這篇論文的損失函數改成：在時間偏移τ、時間縮放s、音高偏移b、音高範圍縮放a四個變換維度上，找出讓重建誤差最小的那一組變換參數，只懲罰「最佳對齊後仍然存在」的誤差，而不是無腦懲罰所有逐幀差異。實際搜尋的變換範圍是：時間縮放{1, 1.08, 1.2}，時間偏移取重新取樣後所有合法位置，音高範圍縮放{0.85, 1.0, 1.15}，音高偏移{-0.1, 0.0, 0.1}。

**實驗資料與設定**：主要資料是約280小時的盤索里錄音，先用HT-Demucs分離人聲，再用CREPE做F0抽取（10毫秒解析度，附信心分數），信心過低的幀被濾掉，間隙在2幀以內的用線性內插補上，含有大量無聲/無音高區間的片段整段捨棄（因為模型沒辦法表示缺失的音高值），訓練/驗證/測試切分為8:1:1。編碼器與解碼器都是6層堆疊的1D卷積，接受域128幀，詞彙表256個條目，訓練5萬步，AdamW，學習率0.001，批次大小1024，量化損失係數β=2.0，選驗證重建損失最低的checkpoint。

**評估一：切割位移一致性**：測試token指派在切割起始位置偏移時是否穩定，分別在偏移0-60幀（小於接受域一半）與0-124幀（幾乎涵蓋整個相位）兩種範圍下，量測token分布的KL散度（越低越好）與token匹配準確率（越高越好）。結果（Table 1）：自編碼器基線的KLD高達1.747(0-60)/2.085(0-124)，準確率只有0.100/0.115；VQ-VAE大幅改善到KLD 0.657/0.859、準確率0.462/0.488；只加時間對齊在這個指標上表現最好（KLD 0.531/0.735、準確率0.519/0.561）；但加上全部四種變換反而在這個特定指標上略微變差（KLD 0.652/0.881、準確率0.456/0.495）——因為音高變換讓「形狀相似但音高不同」的輪廓也能被匹配到同一個token，這對下游任務有利，但對這個嚴格要求「同一段輪廓要對應同一個token」的一致性指標而言是不利的。

**評估二：시김새（sigimsae）分類**：用NIA AI-Hub標籤的韓國傳統音樂資料，「全部」設定有34.0小時、42.3k段、6個sigimsae類別，「純人聲」設定有10.0小時、13.5k段、5個類別，以8:1:1按曲目切分。分類器是用token到標籤的頻率做最大後驗估計（MAP），溫度參數τ用驗證集調校，這是刻意設計成「探測任務」，測試無監督學到的token本身有沒有帶標籤資訊，而不是要打造一個強力分類器。另外拿一個直接用sigimsae全監督訓練的ED-TCN基線做對照（不完全可比，但可看出上限）。結果（Table 2）：自編碼器F1-macro為0.284（全部）/0.324（人聲），VQ-VAE略降到0.266/0.319，加上時間對齊回升到0.285/0.320，加上全部變換達到最佳的0.285/0.331，mAP在全部變換下也是四者中最高（0.278/0.324）；監督式ED-TCN則達到0.463/0.541，顯示無監督token跟全監督基線之間仍有明顯落差，但作者強調「單一token在人聲情境下，不靠序列建模或標籤監督，就能拿到大約五分之三的F1」。質性上，加上全部變換的VQ-VAE學出六個視覺上清楚可分的類別代表token，而自編碼器基線把四個類別混進同一個token裡，說明轉換損失確實把「跟形狀無關的因素」從訓練訊號裡拿掉了，讓輪廓形狀成為詞彙表的主要區辨依據。

**評估三：盤索里調式分析**：用標籤調式的盤索里子集（26.7小時계면조Gyemyeonjo、8.7小時우조Ujo），統計每個token在各調式片段裡出現的次數，找出對每個調式而言P(調式|token)最高的token。結果：token 87對應到「上揚轉音」手法，token 141對應到「下滑輪廓」，兩者都是盤索里研究裡被記錄為계면조典型特徵的裝飾唱法；token 171對應到우조特有的樂句。特別值得一提的是token 54：它代表「向主音下行大二度」的動作，兩個調式都有，但主要出現在우조，區分兩者的關鍵是「上方音在解決到主音之前所加的寬幅顫音」——這代表在完全沒有調式監督的情況下，tokenizer把兩個調式的差異，沿著「裝飾音」這個維度分開了，而這正是音符級轉譜會直接丟掉的訊息。
method.en:
**Architectural foundation**: the model uses 1D convolutional layers with two key design choices. First, receptive-field separation: input is pre-segmented into non-overlapping 128-frame windows, ensuring a 1:1 correspondence between tokens and contour segments, with each segment's median pitch subtracted so the model captures relative rather than absolute pitch movement and avoids inter-token dependencies during decoding. Second, and the core innovation, is a transformation-minimized reconstruction loss: standard frame-level MSE fails because even when two contours correspond to the same local ornamental pattern, a small temporal misalignment inflates the frame-level error. This paper's loss instead searches over four transformation dimensions — temporal offset τ, temporal scale s, pitch offset b, and pitch-range scale a — for whichever combination minimizes reconstruction error, penalizing only the error that remains after optimal alignment rather than blindly penalizing every frame-level discrepancy. The searched ranges are: temporal scales {1, 1.08, 1.2}, all valid temporal offsets from the resampled output, pitch-range scaling {0.85, 1.0, 1.15}, and pitch shifting {-0.1, 0.0, 0.1}.

**Data and setup**: the primary dataset is roughly 280 hours of pansori recordings, with vocals isolated via HT-Demucs and F0 extracted via CREPE (10ms resolution with confidence scores); low-confidence frames are dropped, gaps of ≤2 frames linearly interpolated, and segments with extensive unvoiced regions discarded entirely (since the model cannot represent missing pitch values); the split is 8:1:1 train/validation/test. Encoder and decoder are each 6 stacked 1D conv layers with a 128-frame receptive field, a 256-entry codebook, 50K training updates via AdamW at learning rate 0.001, batch size 1024, quantization loss coefficient β=2.0, selecting the checkpoint with lowest validation reconstruction loss.

**Evaluation 1: segmentation-shift consistency** tests whether token assignments stay stable as the segmentation start position shifts, measured via token-distribution KLD (lower is better) and token-matching accuracy (higher is better) across offset ranges of 0-60 frames (under half the receptive field) and 0-124 frames (near-full phase coverage). Results (Table 1): the autoencoder baseline scores a poor KLD of 1.747(0-60)/2.085(0-124) with accuracy of only 0.100/0.115; VQ-VAE improves substantially to KLD 0.657/0.859, accuracy 0.462/0.488; adding temporal alignment alone performs best on this specific metric (KLD 0.531/0.735, accuracy 0.519/0.561); but adding all four transformations performs slightly worse here (KLD 0.652/0.881, accuracy 0.456/0.495) — because pitch transformations let shape-similar-but-differently-pitched contours match the same token, which helps downstream tasks but hurts this strict same-contour-same-token consistency measure.

**Evaluation 2: sigimsae classification** uses NIA AI-Hub-annotated Korean traditional music: a "full" setting of 34.0 hours/42.3k segments/6 sigimsae classes, and a "vocal-only" setting of 10.0 hours/13.5k segments/5 classes, split 8:1:1 at the track level. The classifier is a token-to-label frequency-based MAP estimator with a validation-tuned temperature τ — deliberately built as a probing task to check whether unsupervised tokens carry label information, not to build a strong classifier — compared against a fully supervised ED-TCN baseline trained directly on sigimsae (not strictly comparable, but indicating an upper bound). Results (Table 2): the autoencoder scores F1-macro 0.284 (full)/0.324 (vocal); VQ-VAE dips slightly to 0.266/0.319; adding temporal alignment recovers to 0.285/0.320; the full transformation setting achieves the best 0.285/0.331, with the highest mAP among the four (0.278/0.324); the supervised ED-TCN reaches 0.463/0.541, showing a clear gap remains between unsupervised tokens and a fully supervised baseline — though the authors note "a single token recovers roughly three-fifths of its F1 on the vocal setting without sequence modeling or label supervision." Qualitatively, the full-transformation VQ-VAE learns six visually distinct class-representative tokens, while the autoencoder baseline conflates four classes into a single token — confirming the transformation loss removes shape-irrelevant factors from the training signal, leaving contour shape as the codebook's main basis for discrimination.

**Evaluation 3: pansori mode analysis** uses a mode-annotated pansori subset (26.7 hours Gyemyeonjo, 8.7 hours Ujo), counting token occurrences within each mode's segments to find, for each mode, the token with the highest P(mode|token). Results: token 87 captures an "upper turn gesture" and token 141 a "downward gliding contour," both documented in pansori scholarship as defining Gyemyeonjo ornaments; token 171 corresponds to phrases characteristic of Ujo. Notably, token 54 represents a "descending major-second motion to the tonic" shared by both modes but occurring predominantly in Ujo — the distinguishing factor being the wide vibrato applied to the upper note before it resolves to the tonic. Without any mode supervision, the tokenizer separated the two modes along exactly this ornamental dimension — a distinction note-level transcription would simply discard.

limitation.zh: 作者明確承認的限制集中在資料涵蓋範圍上。第一，無法處理無聲區間：這個1D-CNN tokenizer假設輸入是密集連續的輪廓，沒辦法直接建模無聲片段，因此訓練與評估都被限縮在「無聲幀很少」的片段裡——這意味著目前這套方法還不能直接套用在完整錄音上，必須先手動篩掉問題片段。第二，無法端對端處理完整錄音：正因為無聲區間處理不了，論文自己承認「要讓模型能端對端地把整段長錄音token化，還需要明確處理無聲區間」，這是被列為未來工作的必要步驟，不是已解決的問題。第三，跟監督式基線之間仍有明顯落差：sigimsae分類的F1在兩種設定下都比ED-TCN低了大約0.2到0.25，說明無監督學到的token雖然帶有標籤資訊，但拿來單獨做分類還遠遠比不上專門訓練的監督式模型——這套方法目前的定位比較像「音樂學分析的輔助工具」，而不是要取代監督式分類器。
limitation.en: The authors' explicitly acknowledged limitations concentrate on data coverage. First, unvoiced regions cannot be handled: the 1D-CNN tokenizer assumes a dense, continuous contour and cannot directly model unvoiced segments, so training and evaluation were restricted to segments with few unvoiced frames — meaning the method cannot yet be applied directly to full recordings without first manually filtering out problematic segments. Second, no end-to-end handling of full recordings: precisely because unvoiced regions aren't handled, the authors concede that "extending the model to handle unvoiced regions explicitly is necessary" for end-to-end tokenization of entire recordings — an acknowledged future-work requirement, not a solved problem. Third, a clear gap remains versus supervised baselines: sigimsae classification F1 trails the ED-TCN baseline by roughly 0.2 to 0.25 in both settings, showing that while unsupervised tokens do carry label information, they're far from matching a purpose-trained supervised classifier on their own — positioning this method more as a musicological analysis aid than a supervised-classifier replacement.

discussion.zh: 三組評估各自驗證了論文的一個主張。切割位移一致性實驗證明「轉換最小化損失」確實解決了它想解決的問題——單純的VQ-VAE已經比自編碼器穩定得多，而額外加上溫和的時間對齊（不含音高變換）在這個指標上表現最好，顯示問題的核心確實出在「時間錯位」而非別的因素。sigimsae分類的探測結果證明，即使沒有任何標籤監督，學出來的token詞彙表仍然帶有跟專家標籤高度相關的資訊，而且質性分析清楚看到VQ-VAE把六個裝飾音類別分進六個視覺上可辨識的token，自編碼器卻把其中四類混成一團——這代表「轉換不變性」這個工程細節，直接轉譯成了「詞彙表更貼近音樂學意義上的分類」這個具體收穫。最有說服力的是調式分析：在完全沒有調式標籤的情況下，tokenizer學出的token不只能對應到既有音樂學研究記錄的裝飾唱法（如계면조的上揚轉音、下滑輪廓），還能在共享同一個「主音下行大二度」動作的兩個調式之間，靠「顫音寬窄」這個純粹裝飾性的維度把它們分開——這正是音符級轉譜會直接丟棄、卻是音樂學家長期關注的細節。作者把這個結果放在更大的脈絡下：西方符號音樂長期享有「切成音符、做n-gram統計、算轉移機率」這類分析工具，而以輪廓為核心的音樂傳統（不只是韓國傳統音樂，也包括印度藝術音樂或流行歌曲的人聲滑音）一直缺少對應的工具，這篇論文的token化方法提供了一條可行路徑，讓這些傳統也能享有同等級的計算分析，雖然距離「端對端處理任意錄音」還有段路要走。
discussion.en: The three evaluations each validate a different piece of the paper's argument. Segmentation-shift consistency confirms the transformation-minimized loss solves the exact problem it targets — plain VQ-VAE is already far more stable than the autoencoder, and adding mild temporal alignment alone (without pitch transformations) performs best on this metric, showing the core issue really is temporal misalignment rather than something else. The sigimsae classification probe shows that even with zero label supervision, the learned token vocabulary carries information highly correlated with expert annotations, and the qualitative analysis clearly shows VQ-VAE separating six ornament classes into six visually distinguishable tokens while the autoencoder conflates four of them — meaning the transformation-invariance engineering detail translates directly into a vocabulary that better matches musicologically meaningful categories. The most persuasive result is the mode analysis: with zero mode supervision, the learned tokens not only correspond to ornamental techniques already documented in pansori scholarship (Gyemyeonjo's upper-turn gesture, downward glide), but also separate two modes that share the same "descending major second to the tonic" gesture, using purely the width of the vibrato as the distinguishing dimension — precisely the kind of detail note-level transcription discards but musicologists have long cared about. The authors situate this in a larger context: Western symbolic music has long enjoyed tools for splitting into notes, computing n-gram statistics, and transition probabilities, while contour-centric traditions (not only Korean traditional music but also Indian art music or vocal glides in pop singing) have lacked equivalent tools — this tokenization method offers a workable path toward giving these traditions the same tier of computational analysis, though there's still distance to travel before it can handle arbitrary full recordings end to end.

entries.title_en: Measuring Cross-Cultural Style Diffusion Through Era Classification: US and Korean Popular Music
entries.title_zh: 透過年代分類量測跨文化風格擴散：美國與韓國流行音樂
entries.authors: Dasol Lee, Minhee Lee, Seonguk Ju, Daewoong Kim, Harin Lee, Dasaem Jeong
entries.why_zh: 既有的跨文化音樂比較大多依賴類型（genre）或情緒標籤，但這些標籤本身就帶著西方偏見。這篇論文換一個角度：把「年代」當成跨文化都通用、不帶文化偏見的比較軸——先用美國Billboard Hot 100的音訊訓練CNN年代分類器，再把它直接套用到韓國Melon排行榜歌曲上，用「模型認為這首韓國歌是哪個年代的美國歌」跟「它實際上市的年代」之間的落差，量化風格擴散的時間差。作者用六種不同架構、三種隨機種子共十八次獨立訓練跑，確認「1960到80年代落後四到五年、90年代驟降到二到三年」這個模式跨架構穩定，並用「原始版跟母帶重製版」的243對錄音做對照實驗，排除「只是母帶風格造成落差」這個混淆因素。方法本身是既有CNN架構的直接應用而非新架構，因此不列為深度分析，但它把一個音樂學命題（文化擴散速度）轉成了可重複驗證的數字，是紮實的量化音樂學研究。
entries.why_en: Most cross-cultural music comparisons rely on genre or mood labels, which themselves carry Western bias. This paper takes a different angle: using chronological era as a culture-agnostic comparison axis. It trains a CNN era classifier on US Billboard Hot 100 audio, then applies it directly to Korean Melon chart songs, using the gap between "which US era the model thinks this Korean song belongs to" and its actual release era to quantify the time lag in style diffusion. The authors ran six different architectures across three random seeds — eighteen independent runs — to confirm the pattern (a 4-5 year lag in the 1960s-80s, sharply narrowing to 2-3 years in the 1990s) holds robustly across architectures, and used 243 original/remastered recording pairs as a control to rule out "it's just mastering style" as a confound. The method itself applies existing CNN architectures rather than introducing a new one, so it isn't flagged as a deep dive, but it turns a musicological claim (the speed of cultural diffusion) into a reproducible, quantified number — solid computational musicology.

motivation.zh: 音樂風格如何跨文化傳播、又如何被在地文化吸收，是音樂學長期關心的問題，但過去的計算方法大多倚賴類型或情緒這類標籤體系去做跨文化比較，而這些標籤體系本身往往帶著明顯的西方中心偏見，拿去套在非西方音樂上時，分類本身就可能是錯的。作者想找一個不需要依賴任何文化特定標籤、卻能量化文化間風格擴散速度的比較軸，而「年代」正好符合這個要求：年代是客觀、跨文化通用的量尺，不需要事先定義「這是什麼類型」。具體做法是：先用美國Billboard排行榜的歌曲訓練一個只認得「這首歌聽起來像哪個年代」的分類器，再把這個分類器直接套用到韓國Melon排行榜歌曲上——如果分類器把一首1970年代的韓國歌判斷成「聽起來像1965年的美國歌」，這個落差本身就是一個可以量化、可以逐年代追蹤的「風格擴散延遲」指標。
motivation.en: How musical styles diffuse across cultures and get locally absorbed is a long-standing musicological question, but prior computational approaches mostly lean on genre or mood taxonomies for cross-cultural comparison — taxonomies that themselves often carry substantial Western bias, so the classification itself may already be wrong when applied to non-Western music. The authors wanted a comparison axis that needs no culture-specific labeling scheme yet still quantifies the speed of cross-cultural style diffusion, and chronological era fits that requirement: era is an objective, culture-independent yardstick that requires no prior "what genre is this" definition. Concretely: train a classifier on US Billboard-chart songs that only learns "which era does this sound like," then apply that same classifier directly to Korean Melon-chart songs — if the classifier judges a 1970s Korean song as "sounding like a 1965 American song," that gap is itself a quantifiable, decade-trackable measure of style-diffusion lag.

intro.zh: 論文的歷史脈絡是：韓國流行音樂透過長期接觸西方風格發展而成，最早的管道是1960年代駐韓美軍基地的現場演出，後來隨著媒體基礎設施擴張而擴大；신중현（Shin Joong-hyun）引進迷幻搖滾是關鍵人物之一，1992年出道的서태지와 아이들（Seo Taiji and Boys）則帶動了整個產業轉型，把韓國流行音樂推向當代K-pop的樣貌。計算方法上，過去研究（如Serrà等人、Million Song Dataset相關工作）分析過音高、音色、響度等特徵跨十年的變化趨勢，也有研究追蹤過Billboard內部風格聚類的變化，但這些大多停留在「描述某個市場內部的風格演變」，沒有做跨市場、跨文化的直接比較。既有的跨文化MIR比較大多倚賴類型或情緒標籤體系，而這類標籤體系存在明顯的文化偏誤。這篇論文的創新在於把「跨域推論」本身當成分析工具：不是去描述韓國或美國各自的風格演變，而是用「年代/年份預測」當成一個跨文化同步程度的量測透鏡，用「時序」這個不帶文化偏見的軸取代類型或情緒標籤。
intro.en: The paper's historical framing: Korean popular music developed through sustained exposure to Western styles, initially via live performances at US military bases in the 1960s, later expanding alongside media infrastructure; Shin Joong-hyun, who introduced psychedelic rock, was a key early figure, and Seo Taiji and Boys (debuting 1992) catalyzed an industry-wide transformation that pushed Korean pop toward what became contemporary K-pop. On the computational side, prior work (e.g. Serrà et al., Million Song Dataset-related studies) examined trends in pitch, timbre, and loudness across decades, and other studies tracked stylistic clustering shifts within Billboard — but these mostly describe style evolution within a single market, without direct cross-market, cross-cultural comparison. Existing cross-cultural MIR comparisons mostly rely on genre or mood taxonomies, which carry clear cultural bias. This paper's innovation is treating cross-domain inference itself as the analytical tool: rather than describing Korean or American style evolution separately, it uses era/year prediction as a lens for measuring cross-cultural synchronization, replacing genre or mood labels with chronological time as a culture-independent axis.

method.zh:
**資料集**：Billboard方面蒐集了1958年到2024年3月共31,092筆不重複排行榜紀錄，透過YouTube取得22,002首歌的音訊，並過濾出原版錄音，同時移除68首掛名韓國創作者的曲目，確保「美國流行音樂」這個域保持乾淨、不受汙染。Melon方面約2,200首有音訊的歌曲（1964到2009年），刻意把時間上限設在2009年，是為了研究「單向的風格吸收」——也就是在K-pop於2010年代全球化、韓流開始反向影響美國之前的那段時期。年代標籤採用「上榜日期」而非「發行日期」，理由是上榜日期更直接反映這首歌實際被商業流通、被聽眾聽到的時間點。切分資料時建構了藝人合作關係圖，確保訓練/驗證/測試切分不會讓同一位歌手的聲音同時出現在訓練集與測試集（避免模型學到的是「認聲音」而非「認年代」），切分比例約8:1:1，並對各年代做類別平衡的欠採樣以緩解年代間資料量不均的問題。

**分層式年代預測**：模型不是單純做扁平的年份分類，而是同時在四個層級聯合預測：年代（decade）、半年代（five-year）、四分之一年代（2.5-year）、以及年份（year）。1958-1959年併入1960年代，2020-2024年併入2010年代。損失函數是所有層級的交叉熵總和，再加上一個懲罰「父子層預測互相矛盾」的階層一致性項（權重λ=1）。核心量測指標是年代落差：Δ(s) = ê(s) − e_s，其中ê是模型預測的年代、e_s是這首歌實際上榜的年代。

**音訊表徵與訓練**：音訊轉成單聲道、16kHz，刻意捨棄立體聲資訊與8kHz以上的高頻，目的是消除混音與母帶處理帶來的偽影；訓練時每個epoch隨機裁切30秒片段；用Adam優化器，學習率1×10⁻⁴，批次大小64，訓練3萬次迭代，每500次迭代驗證一次，保留巨集準確率最高的checkpoint；訓練批次對各年代做欠採樣，以資料量最少的2000年代（1,585首）為基準。

**模型選擇策略**：為了避免預訓練資料外洩問題（MERT、Jukebox等預訓練模型很可能已經看過韓國音樂），六種CNN架構全部從頭訓練，包括FCN、ShortChunkCNN、ShortChunkCNN_Res、musicnn、CRNN，以及一個三層卷積的簡單基線，參數量從86k到837k不等，每種架構跑三個隨機種子，共十八次獨立訓練跑。

**域內Billboard表現**：年代層級的巨集準確率在各架構間落在67.0%到71.2%之間，遠高於16.7%的隨機猜測基準；年份層級的混淆矩陣顯示預測集中在對角線附近，說明模型確實學到了有意義的時序梯度；2010年代的準確率較弱，可能反映近期音樂本身風格更多元。

**跨域推論（Billboard→Melon，主要發現）**：各年代的年代落差中位數（Table 3）：1960年代−4.7年（標準差±0.6）、1970年代−4.5年（±0.7）、1980年代−4.1年（±0.8）、1990年代驟降到−2.4年（±0.8）、2000年代−2.7年（±1.4）。重要的對照組是：Billboard訓練出的模型在Billboard自己的保留測試集上幾乎沒有偏移（每個年代域內落差中位數都在±0.2年以內），確認前述的落差反映的是跨域的真實文化差距，而不是模型本身系統性偏誤。2000年代的預測呈現雙峰：舞曲/嘻哈類藝人（BigBang、2NE1、Epik High）被判斷得很準（接近實際年代），而抒情/R&B歌手（SG Wannabe、Brown Eyes）仍被判斷得比實際晚了好幾年。

**跨架構一致性**：六種架構全部把1970年代音樂判斷得偏早（落差3.7到6.5年），其中四種架構顯示落差往2000年代收斂到4到6年，另外兩種（簡單基線幾乎不動、musicnn反而略微加大落差）則有分歧，顯示整體趨勢穩健，但確實存在架構相依的細節差異。

**反向推論（Melon→Billboard）**：用Melon訓練出的模型去判斷Billboard歌曲，呈現互補的模式：美國歌曲被判斷得比實際「更晚」，1960年代落差約10年，到2000年代收斂到接近零。但Melon模型本身巨集準確率只有52.4%（相對Billboard模型的76.3%），1960年代準確率更只有9.5%（訓練樣本只有34首），作者把這個反向結果解讀為「印證方向、但不強調數值精確度」。
method.en:
**Datasets**: on the Billboard side, the team collected 31,092 unique chart entries spanning 1958 to March 2024, retrieving audio for 22,002 tracks via YouTube with filtering for original recordings, and removed 68 Korean-credited tracks to keep the "US pop" domain uncontaminated. Melon contributes roughly 2,200 tracks with audio (1964-2009), deliberately capped at 2009 to study unidirectional style adoption — the period before K-pop's 2010s globalization began influencing the US in the other direction. Era labels use chart-entry date rather than release date, since chart-entry date more directly reflects when a song actually circulated commercially and reached listeners. Splits were built using artist-collaboration graphs so the same singer's voice never appears in both train and test (preventing the model from learning "recognize the voice" instead of "recognize the era"), at roughly an 8:1:1 ratio, with class-balanced undersampling across decades to offset uneven data volume.

**Hierarchical era prediction**: rather than flat year classification, the model jointly predicts four levels simultaneously — decade, half-decade, quarter-decade, and year. 1958-1959 is grouped with the 1960s, 2020-2024 with the 2010s. The loss is the sum of cross-entropy across all levels plus a hierarchical-consistency penalty (λ=1) that punishes parent-child prediction contradictions. The core metric is the era offset: Δ(s) = ê(s) − e_s, where ê is the predicted era and e_s the song's actual chart-entry era.

**Audio representation and training**: audio is converted to mono, 16kHz, deliberately discarding stereo information and frequencies above 8kHz to eliminate mixing/mastering artifacts; random 30-second crops are taken per epoch during training; Adam optimizer at learning rate 1×10⁻⁴, batch size 64, 30,000 iterations, validated every 500 iterations, keeping the checkpoint with highest macro accuracy; training batches are undersampled to match the smallest decade class (2000s: 1,585 tracks).

**Model selection strategy**: to avoid pretraining data leakage (models like MERT or Jukebox likely already saw Korean music), six CNN architectures were trained entirely from scratch — FCN, ShortChunkCNN, ShortChunkCNN_Res, musicnn, CRNN, and a simple 3-conv-layer baseline — ranging from 86k to 837k parameters, each run across three random seeds for 18 total independent runs.

**In-domain Billboard performance**: decade-level macro accuracy ranges 67.0%-71.2% across architectures, well above the 16.7% chance baseline; the year-level confusion matrix clusters near the diagonal, confirming the model learned a meaningful temporal gradient; accuracy weakens in the 2010s, possibly reflecting greater recent stylistic diversity.

**Cross-domain inference (Billboard→Melon, the main finding)**: median era offsets by decade (Table 3): 1960s −4.7 years (SD ±0.6), 1970s −4.5 years (±0.7), 1980s −4.1 years (±0.8), 1990s sharply narrowing to −2.4 years (±0.8), 2000s −2.7 years (±1.4). A crucial control: Billboard-trained models show almost no offset on Billboard's own held-out test set (in-domain median offset within ±0.2 years per decade), confirming the offset above reflects a genuine cross-domain cultural gap, not systematic model bias. The 2000s predictions are bimodal: dance/hip-hop acts (BigBang, 2NE1, Epik High) are dated accurately near their real era, while ballad/R&B singers (SG Wannabe, Brown Eyes) are still back-dated by several years.

**Cross-architecture consistency**: all six architectures back-date 1970s music (offset 3.7-6.5 years), and four of the six show the offset narrowing to 4-6 years by the 2000s, while two dissent (the simple baseline barely moves; musicnn's offset widens slightly) — indicating the overall pattern is robust while some architecture-dependent detail exists.

**Reverse inference (Melon→Billboard)**: a Melon-trained model judging Billboard songs shows a complementary pattern — US songs are dated as "later" than they are, by about 10 years in the 1960s, narrowing to near zero by the 2000s. But the Melon model's own macro accuracy is only 52.4% (versus Billboard's 76.3%), with 1960s accuracy at just 9.5% (only 34 training tracks) — the authors read this reverse result as "corroborating direction rather than precise magnitude."

limitation.zh: 作者明確列出幾項限制。第一，「風格」跟「製作」混雜：梅爾頻譜圖同時捕捉磁帶噪訊、壓縮、母帶處理跟和聲、編曲等音樂內容，作者坦承「量到的落差有一部分很可能是製作滯後而非風格滯後」，也就是說，論文量到的「4到5年落差」不能簡單地解讀成「純粹的音樂風格擴散延遲」，錄音與混音技術的擴散速度也摻在裡面。第二，顆粒度問題：30秒的裁切片段沒辦法捕捉整首歌的段落結構；藝人感知的切分方式也沒辦法控制製作人、錄音工程師、作曲人這些幕後角色的重疊。第三，單曲精確度不足：同一首歌不同裁切片段預測結果的變異，Billboard的標準差是3.3年、Melon是6.0年，所以「年代中位數」是靠平均把這些雜訊蓋掉的，對單一首歌做精確定年並不可靠。第四，音訊來源：YouTube比對到的音訊「不一定是原始錄音版本」。第五，排行榜資料反映的是「流通」時間點而非「製作」時間點，兩個語料庫本身跨越的年份範圍也不對稱。不過作者也做了兩個對照排除混淆因素：243對原版/母帶重製版的比較顯示，重製後的落差有的變早有的變晚，分布平均，說明母帶風格本身不是驅動整體結果的主因；只用比對品質最好的80%音訊重跑，各年代中位數的變化都不超過0.5年，說明音訊比對誤差也不是主要驅動因素。
limitation.en: The authors list several explicit limitations. First, style and production are conflated: mel-spectrograms capture tape noise, compression, and mastering equally alongside harmony and arrangement, and the authors acknowledge that "part of the measured offset is likely production lag rather than stylistic lag" — meaning the paper's headline 4-5 year gap can't simply be read as pure musical-style diffusion delay; the diffusion speed of recording and mixing technology is mixed in too. Second, granularity issues: 30-second crops can't capture a song's overall formal structure, and artist-aware splitting doesn't control for overlapping producers, engineers, or songwriters behind the scenes. Third, individual-song precision is limited: prediction variance across different crops of the same song has a standard deviation of 3.3 years (Billboard) and 6.0 years (Melon), so decade medians average out this noise but individual songs can't be dated precisely. Fourth, audio source: YouTube-matched audio "is not always the original recording." Fifth, chart data reflects circulation timing rather than production timing, and the two corpora span asymmetric year ranges. That said, the authors ran two controls to rule out confounds: 243 original/remastered pairs show changes split roughly evenly between earlier and later, indicating mastering style alone isn't driving the overall result; and restricting to the best-matched 80% of audio moves no decade median by more than 0.5 years, indicating audio-matching error isn't a major driver either.

discussion.zh: 作者把「年代落差」重新框架成「跨文化音樂流動之演變中的結構性條件的痕跡」，而不是單純的模仿程度指標。1960到80年代之間穩定的四到五年落差，對應到當時有限的傳播管道（駐韓美軍基地演出、AFKN電台）——這段時期跨藝人跨曲風都呈現一致的4到6年延遲（例：최희준Choi Hee-jun−6.1年、산울림Sanullim−5.2年），顯示這是基礎設施驅動的系統性延遲，而非個別藝人的問題。1990年代是關鍵轉折點：落差驟降到2到3年，對應到서태지와 아이들（Seo Taiji and Boys，1992年出道）帶來的產業重組——這個組合本身在整體上仍被判斷為落後2.4年，但個別測量下卻呈現「領先於上榜日期」的罕見模式（平均+2.8年，18次跑裡有15次為正值），而且他們的落差分布橫跨15年之廣（相對鄰近藝人只有6到7年），反映其音樂實驗跨度極廣。更重要的是，서태지와 아이들打破了廣播電視台的壟斷，讓SM娛樂、YG娛樂等經紀公司得以製作面向全球的音樂人才，像BigBang（YG，2007-09年）、少女時代（SM，2007-09年）在論文的量測裡都呈現接近零的落差。整體而言，這篇論文的價值在於把一個原本只能靠質性歷史敘述去講的命題——「韓國流行音樂如何、以多快的速度吸收西方風格」——轉成一組可重複驗證的數字，並透過243對母帶重製版對照與音訊比對品質篩選，把「這只是錄音技術差異」的疑慮排除掉。它也提出了具體的未來方向：把同樣的框架套用到其他國家的排行榜配對上、找出到底是哪些聲學線索驅動了這個落差、以及用年代推論去找出單一語料庫裡「時代錯置」的藝人（例如披頭四The Beatles在18次跑裡有15次被判斷得比同代人晚了大約2年，反映他們超前時代的錄音室製作手法）。
discussion.en: The authors reframe the era offset not as a simple imitation metric but as "a trace of the evolving structural conditions of cross-cultural music flows." The stable 4-5 year lag from the 1960s through the 1980s corresponds to the limited distribution channels of the time (US military base performances, AFKN radio) — this period shows a consistent 4-6 year delay across artists and genres alike (e.g. Choi Hee-jun −6.1 years, Sanullim −5.2 years), indicating an infrastructure-driven systemic delay rather than an artist-specific one. The 1990s mark the key inflection point: the gap sharply narrows to 2-3 years, corresponding to the industry restructuring triggered by Seo Taiji and Boys (debuting 1992) — while the group as a whole is still measured as 2.4 years behind at the decade level, individual measurements show a rare pattern of being ahead of their chart date (mean +2.8 years, positive in 15 of 18 runs), with an unusually wide 15-year offset spread (versus 6-7 years for adjacent artists) reflecting the breadth of their sonic experimentation. More importantly, Seo Taiji and Boys broke the broadcast networks' monopoly, enabling talent agencies like SM Entertainment and YG Entertainment to produce globally oriented acts — BigBang (YG, 2007-09) and Girls' Generation (SM, 2007-09) both register near-zero offsets in the paper's measurements. Overall, this paper's value lies in converting a claim previously arguable only through qualitative historical narrative — how, and how fast, did Korean pop absorb Western style — into a set of reproducible numbers, ruling out "this is just recording-technology difference" via the 243 remastered-pair control and audio-match-quality filtering. It also proposes concrete future directions: applying the same framework to other national chart pairs, identifying which specific acoustic cues drive the offset, and using era inference to surface anachronistic artists within a single corpus (e.g. the Beatles were dated roughly 2 years later than their contemporaries in 15 of 18 runs, reflecting their studio production being ahead of its time).
